newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SIA sees more non-Singapore revenue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SIA sees more non-Singapore revenue.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) chief executive Cheong Choong Kong said on Tuesday he expected more of the airline's revenue to come from outside Singapore as the carrier continued to outsource some of its activities.

"I would like to see eventually a larger part of our revenues coming from activities based outside of Singapore," Cheong said at the National Aviation Press Club of Australia in answer to a question. Cheong said a lot of the airline's accounting was being performed in Beijing, where the airline set up a company in the Chinese capital and then awarded it all of the carrier's accounting software to do the accounts.
Cheong said SIA had set up a joint venture with the Tata group in Madras, India to carry out a lot of the airline's computer software work.
"I see more and more of this happening," Cheong said.
He said there were also a lot of opportunities to outsource work done in Singapore to other countries in Asia as the island state faced a labour shortage.
